title: M6 character orthogonality and general weighted MacWilliams over integer polynomials
scope: Original M6 sections4/5 generic character foundation. Exact weighted integer-polynomial formula is proved from binary subspace orthogonality; pinned specialization follows using M6.Pinned frozen definitions. No cyclic squarefree restriction or formula hypothesis.

spec.name: M6.Character.orthogonality
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Submodule (ZMod 2) (M6.Character.Vector m)) (z : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.characterSum D z = M6.Character.orthogonalIndicator D z
queries: finite binary character orthogonality sum translation
spec.guidance: Unfold orthogonalIndicator to the exact if Orthogonal then card else0 statement. Inside orthogonal all characters1. Outside obtain q0∈D with dot q0 z≠0, hence character q0z=-1. Translation by q0 bijects finite subspaceWords; character_add gives sum=-sum and integer cancellation gives0. Prove translation/reindex; do not assume orthogonality formula. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M6.Character.weighted_factorization
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → ZMod 2 → Polynomial ℤ) (q : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.localTransform w q = ∑ z : M6.Character.Vector m, Polynomial.C (M6.Character.character q z) * ∏ i, w i (z i)
queries: finite binary character orthogonality sum translation
spec.guidance: Fintype.prod_sum expands coordinate factors. Finset.prod_mul_distrib and map_prod combine character factors, then character_product. Integer polynomial arithmetic, no division. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M6.Character.weighted_macwilliams
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Submodule (ZMod 2) (M6.Character.Vector m)) (w : Fin m → ZMod 2 → Polynomial ℤ), Polynomial.C ((M6.Character.subspaceWords D).card : ℤ) * M6.Character.weightedDual D w = M6.Character.weightedTransform D w
queries: finite binary character orthogonality sum translation
spec.guidance: Expand weightedTransform using weighted_factorization, swap the two finite sums once, collect Polynomial.C(characterSum), use orthogonality, and identify dualWords filter. No formula premise or rational normalization; exact integer polynomial identity. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve exact target.
